quotes.summary_phrase: Clay Thompson's performance and the Heat's offensive strategy
quotes.excerpt: Clay Thompson has been on a tear. Part of this stretch, I was in LA the night that he had 30.
quotes.quote: Clay Thompson has been on a tear. Part of this stretch, I was in LA the night that he had 30 and hit, I couldn't believe this, it was the first go-ahead three in the final five seconds of his career. And it was a great play, Bam set an iconic screen to free him for it. But Clay in this stretch is averaging 18.5 points and shooting 46% from three on over 10 attempts per game. Clay came to Dallas hoping he would get spoon-fed a bunch of wide-open threes.
